mainEntity.name: How do you play a Sliding Puzzle game online?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choose a grid size, then slide the tiles by moving the empty box. Your goal is to arrange numbers in order as fast as possible.

mainEntity.name: What makes the Sliding Number Puzzle beneficial for our brain?

acceptedAnswer.text: It enhances problem-solving, memory, and concentration by constantly challenging your logic and planning abilities and sharpness.

mainEntity.name: Can I use a sliding tile puzzle solver if I'm stuck?
